intro: A sequence policy optimization derivation for regression.

blocks.name: sequence objective
blocks.raw:
J_GSPO(θ) = E_{x~D, {y_i}~π_old} [ (1/G) Σ_{i=1}^{G} min( s_i(θ) · Â_i,
                                                        clip(s_i(θ), 1−ε, 1+ε) · Â_i ) ]

blocks.name: sequence gradient
blocks.raw: ∇_θ J_GSPO = E[ (1/G) Σ_i s_i(θ) · Â_i · (1/|y_i|) Σ_t ∇_θ log π_θ(y_{i,t} | x, y_{i,<t}) ]

blocks.name: token gradient and weight
blocks.raw:
∇_θ J_GRPO = E[ (1/G) Σ_i Â_i · (1/|y_i|) Σ_t w_{i,t}(θ) · ∇_θ log π_θ(y_{i,t} | x, y_{i,<t}) ]

w_{i,t}(θ) = π_θ(y_{i,t} | ·) / π_old(y_{i,t} | ·)

blocks.name: custom stop gradient and token objective
blocks.raw:
s_{i,t}(θ) = sg[ s_i(θ) ] · π_θ(y_{i,t} | x, y_{i,<t}) / sg[ π_θ(y_{i,t} | x, y_{i,<t}) ]

J_GSPO-token(θ) = E[ (1/G) Σ_i (1/|y_i|) Σ_t min( s_{i,t}(θ) · Â_{i,t},
                                                  clip(s_{i,t}(θ), 1−ε, 1+ε) · Â_{i,t} ) ]
